In corporate disputes, Anthony Pompliano’s potential $400 million payout from ProCap’s Bitcoin DAT is being challenged by Glazer Capital ahead of the December merger vote. Looking ahead, India announced plans to launch a stablecoin called ARC—pegged 1:1 to the rupee under its CBDC framework—in Q1 2026.

a cryptocurrency-mixing service used by cybercriminals to launder Bitcoin,  
seizing millions in crypto, critical servers, and terabytes of data.

agencies from Switzerland and Germany, coordinated by Europol, reportedly targeted  
Cryptomixer, a crypto-mixing service alleged to have laundered over €1.3  
billion ($1.51 billion) in Bitcoin since 2016. 
According to Europol, authorities confiscated three  
servers, the platform’s domain, more than €25 million ($29 million) in BTC, and  
over 12 terabytes of operational data.
